sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It targets iceStringer, encodes the outside/supporting applicability alternatives with required selectors, uses the declared operands and owner, explicitly reconciles span with stringerSpan, applies the correct distance-based factor, unit scaling, fixed factors, permitted arithmetic, and expected-result-scaled tolerances for all derived calculations.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the candidate applies the calculation to every nltl:iceStringer but does not encode the requirement's applicability boundary for a stringer situated outside the ice belt and supporting ice-strengthened frames. Add the supplied locatedOutsideIceBelt and supportsIceStrengthenedFrames conditions, or an equivalent verified applicability structure, without inventing a convenience boolean. Also ensure every declared operand is semantically used: span is constrained but ignored by the formula, while only stringerSpan supplies l; reconcile these operands with the verified model rather than leaving span as a redundant mandatory fact.

Reject. The formula uses stringerSpan as both l and l_s, but the verified requirement requires l_s to be distanceToAdjacentIceStringer; add that supplied canonical operand on the iceStringer and use it in outsideIceBeltFactor = 1 - distanceToIceBelt/distanceToAdjacentIceStringer. Preserve the prior span instruction by making any span/stringerSpan correspondence explicit only if required, without substituting it for the adjacent-stringer distance. Also reconcile the unit scale: designLineLoad is declared in kN/m, whereas p*h yields MN/m, so compare its numeric value with 1000*max(p*h,0.15) (while retaining the appropriate MN/m value in the Z and A formulas). Finally, DIRECT_CALCULATION permits only the registered arithmetic, comparisons, min/max, and simple piecewise operations; replace the unregistered ABS calls in tolerance construction with permitted expressions or an equivalent bounded formula. Keep the existing applicability evidence and do not allow either not-applicable branch to pass with missing selector values.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unknown canonical benchmark IRI(s): https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_ApplicableShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_DesignHeightShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_DesignLineLoadShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_IceBeltDistanceShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_IcePressureShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_IceStringerShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_MomentFactorShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_NotApplicableOutsideShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_NotApplicableSupportShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_OutsideFactorShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_QuantityValueShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_SectionModulusShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_ShearAreaShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_SpanShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_StringerSpanShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF054_YieldStrengthShape
Semantic validator feedback: Reject. deterministicValidation.valid is false because the invented nltl:TRF054_* shape IRIs are unknown canonical benchmark IRIs; replace them with blank-node shapes or non-vocabulary SHACL shape identifiers. Preserve the prior applicability requirements and correct the formula operands: add supplied canonical nltl:distanceToAdjacentIceStringer, use it as l_s in 1 - h_s/l_s, and use nltl:stringerSpan as l in the Z and A formulas. Do not leave the declared span operand as an ignored mandatory fact; encode its verified correspondence or otherwise use it as required by the dependency contract. Keep designLineLoad in kN/m compared against 1000*max(p*h,0.15), while retaining MN/m scaling in Z and A, and retain permitted bounded tolerances rather than exact equality for derived results. Move minExclusive constraints from the quantity-value property assertions onto qudt:numericValue constraints.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It targets iceStringer, encodes the outside/supporting applicability alternatives with required selectors, uses the declared operands and owner, explicitly reconciles span with stringerSpan, applies the correct distance-based factor, unit scaling, fixed factors, permitted arithmetic, and expected-result-scaled tolerances for all derived calculations.
